what: WOW.js-style reveal — pieces stay hidden, and once even one cell of a piece enters the screen, an animate.css effect (zoomIn, fadeInDown, bounceIn, pulse, rotateInDownLeft, bounceInRight, swing …) plays once after its delay (animate.css default 1s, each effect with its own curve). Like the hand-drawn shop Hero, give each piece a different delay so they pop out one by one

options.name: animate.css effect name, default fadeIn
options.delay: Delay from lift to start (s) — WOW data-wow-delay
options.dur: Effect duration (seconds), default animate.css 1s — WOW data-wow-duration
options.offset: Must come in this many px more from the bottom of the screen before it triggers, default 0 — WOW offset

note: Load ../_vendor/animate.css@3.1.1/animate.css first. Like WOW, once triggered it does not hide again

from.where: All .wow pieces in index.html·flow.html·article.html (WOW v1.0.3 · animate.css 3 — hero oval frame zoomIn 0~1.2s, bear photo pulse 2.2s · 3s, right column fadeInDown 0~1.2s, silhouette panel fadeIn .4s, material bear bounceInRight .6s · 2s, prop bear rotateInDownLeft .4s, contact button bounceIn .4s, flow steps bounceIn .6~1.2s)
Footer .s-foot__chars — five characters with bounceInUp at .2s intervals (the site uses wow.js as is, like the original)
